items.title: Meta與中國傅利葉智能合作開發人形機器人？網傳Max僅48公斤、3個月打造
items.title_en: Meta and China’s Fourier Intelligence Collaborate on Humanoid Robot? Rumors Claim Max Weighs 48 kg and Was Built in 3 Months
paras: 社群平台X近日流傳消息，指Meta(META-US) 與中國機器人製造商傅利葉智能（Fourier Intelligence）合作開發一款名為Max的人形機器人，重量約48公斤，從概念發想到實際硬體成形僅花3個月。不過，目前這項消息尚未獲得雙方證實，也沒有公開技術文件或官方公告可以佐證，雙方是否建立正式合作關係仍不明朗。
外媒報導指出，相關調查顯示，目前找不到Meta或傅利葉智能曾發布名為Max的人形機器人，或共同開發相關產品的正式資訊。截至2026年10月，也沒有證據顯示兩家公司已建立正式合作關係。因此，網傳Max的名稱、重量及開發時程，目前都缺乏可供查證的公開資料。
《The Information》週六（31日）亦引述知情人士報導，Meta已與中國新創公司傅利葉智能共同打造一款人形機器人原型，目前正著手開發第二代版本。但《路透》表示目前尚無法立即查證這項報導。
傅利葉智能並非人形機器人領域的新進業者。公司2015年於上海成立，早期主要開發復健外骨骼設備，協助患者恢復肢體活動能力，2023年7月進一步推出GR-1人形機器人，正式拓展人形機器人業務。
此後，傅利葉智能陸續布局GR系列產品。其中，GR-2重量63公斤、身高175公分，具備53個自由度，原定於2024年9月至10月推出；GR-3則預計於2025年8月亮相，重量約71公斤、身高約165公分，具備55個自由度，並透過增加關節活動能力，強化照護相關應用。
不過，傅利葉智能目前公開的人形機器人產品線中，並沒有名為Max的機型。若網傳48公斤的重量屬實，也將比GR-2及GR-3都輕，與公司現有產品規格有所不同。
此外，傅利葉智能目前公開布局的重點也偏向情感陪伴與高齡照護，而非與Meta合作開發新型機器人。
相較於網傳與傅利葉智能合作的消息，Meta進軍機器人領域則有較明確的公開發展。Meta於2025年在旗下Reality Labs部門成立機器人研究團隊，該部門原本主要負責虛擬實境（VR）及擴增實境（AR）硬體業務。
這支團隊由自動駕駛公司Cruise前執行長Marc Whitten領導。Meta將機器人視為可能具有與AR業務同等重要性的長期投資方向，顯示公司正擴大人工智慧（AI）與硬體技術的布局。
此外，Meta於2026年5月收購Assured Robot Intelligence，進一步強化人形機器人AI技術能力。
不過，這些布局目前仍不足以證明Meta已與傅利葉智能合作，或共同開發名為Max的機器人。
paras_en: A recent rumor circulating on X claims that Meta (META-US) and Chinese robot manufacturer Fourier Intelligence have teamed up to develop a humanoid robot named Max, weighing about 48 kg and taking only three months from concept to hardware. However, neither party has confirmed the story, and no technical documents or official announcements exist to substantiate it, leaving the existence of a formal partnership unclear.

Foreign media reports indicate that no evidence has been found that Meta or Fourier Intelligence has released a humanoid robot called Max or jointly developed such a product. As of October 2026, there is no proof that the two companies have established a formal collaboration, and the rumored name, weight, and development timeline lack verifiable public data.

The Information cited insiders on Saturday (31st) saying Meta has worked with the Chinese startup Fourier Intelligence to create a humanoid robot prototype and is now developing a second‑generation version, but Reuters stated that the claim could not be immediately verified.

Fourier Intelligence is not a newcomer to the humanoid robot field. Founded in Shanghai in 2015, the company initially focused on rehabilitation exoskeletons to help patients regain limb function, and in July 2023 it expanded into humanoid robotics with the launch of the GR‑1.

Since then, Fourier Intelligence has rolled out the GR series. The GR‑2 weighs 63 kg, stands 175 cm tall, has 53 degrees of freedom, and was slated for release between September and October 2024; the GR‑3 is expected to debut in August 2025, weighing about 71 kg, standing roughly 165 cm tall, with 55 degrees of freedom and enhanced joint mobility for caregiving applications.

However, none of Fourier Intelligence’s publicly listed humanoid models is named Max. If the rumored 48‑kg weight is accurate, it would be lighter than both the GR‑2 and GR‑3, differing from the company’s current specifications.
Moreover, Fourier Intelligence’s current public focus is on emotional companionship and eldercare, rather than collaborating with Meta on a new robot.

In contrast to the unverified partnership rumors, Meta’s entry into robotics has clearer public developments. In 2025, Meta’s Reality Labs division established a robotics research team, a unit that had previously concentrated on virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR) hardware.

The team is led by Marc Whitten, former CEO of autonomous‑driving firm Cruise. Meta regards robotics as a long‑term investment potentially as important as its AR business, signaling an expansion of its AI and hardware strategy.
In May 2026, Meta acquired Assured Robot Intelligence to further strengthen its humanoid robot AI capabilities.
Nonetheless, these moves do not yet prove that Meta has partnered with Fourier Intelligence or jointly developed a robot named Max.

items.title: 美股亂流引發台股賣壓 法人仍看好中長期基本面支撐、留意個股分化趨勢
items.title_en: U.S. Market Turbulence Triggers Selling Pressure on Taiwan Stocks; Institutions Remain Bullish on Mid‑to‑Long‑Term Fundamentals and Watch for Stock‑Specific Divergence
paras: 受美股科技股震盪與財報雜音干擾，台股近期賣壓增溫，指數劇烈波動並反覆測試底部。法人指出，雖然短線市場情緒趨於保守，致使部分亮眼財報面臨獲利了結賣壓；但從中長期來看，美國雲端巨頭AI資本支出未減，台灣半導體與科技供應鏈的關鍵地位依舊穩固。在評價與高波動並存的環境下，拉回反倒提供了中長線分批布局與多元配置的良機。
針對近期盤勢，安聯台灣大壩基金暨安聯台灣科技基金經理人蕭惠中表示，國際情勢、利率走勢、聯準會政策預期與AI投資疑慮等雜音持續干擾市場，導致短期投資情緒凌駕基本面，資金動能轉趨保守。即使部分企業繳出亮眼財報，仍面臨獲利了結賣壓，致使台股短線波動明顯放大。
蕭惠中指出，雖然短線市場將反覆測試底部，但台灣科技產業的基本面並未出現轉折。美國大型雲端服務業者持續擴大AI資本支出，雲端及先進運算需求維持強勁成長，且半導體與AI相關供應鏈訂單、營收動能無虞。隨著新一代伺服器逐步出貨，相關企業第四季營收可望延續成長力道，企業獲利仍是支撐台股中長期走勢的核心基石。
隨著市場進入高利率、高評價與高波動並存的環境，聯準會利率政策、美債殖利率及地緣政治對通膨的影響仍是後續主要變數。預期台股行情將由過去的全面齊漲，逐步轉向產業與個股分化，資金將更聚焦於營收及EPS成長能見度高的企業。
在產業配置方面，安聯台灣高息成長主動式ETF(00984A-TW)經理人廖本隆指出，目前投資組合以金融控股為最大產業配置，藉此提升持股多元性，並掌握市場資金輪動機會；成長布局則廣泛涵蓋半導體晶圓代工、先進封裝、記憶體、IC設計、半導體設備、PCB、工業電腦及散熱等科技供應鏈，持續掌握AI與高效能運算需求成長所帶動的結構性投資機會。
paras_en: The recent sell‑off in Taiwan equities has intensified as U.S. tech stocks wobble and earnings noise creates interference, causing the index to swing wildly and repeatedly test its lows. Institutions note that while short‑term market sentiment has become cautious—leading to profit‑taking pressure on some standout earnings—the mid‑to‑long‑term outlook remains solid: U.S. cloud giants continue robust AI capital spending and Taiwan’s semiconductor and tech supply chain retains its pivotal role. In a setting of high valuations and volatility, the pullback actually offers a good chance for phased, diversified positioning over the medium to long term.

Regarding the latest market action, Allianz Taiwan Dam Fund and Allianz Taiwan Tech Fund manager Hsu Hui‑Chung said that international developments, interest‑rate trends, Fed policy expectations and AI‑investment concerns continue to cloud the market, causing short‑term sentiment to outweigh fundamentals and capital flows to become more conservative. Even companies delivering impressive earnings face profit‑taking pressure, amplifying short‑term volatility in Taiwan stocks.

Hsu pointed out that although the short‑term market will keep testing the bottom, the fundamentals of Taiwan’s tech industry have not turned. Major U.S. cloud service providers are still expanding AI capital expenditures, keeping demand for cloud and high‑performance computing strong, and semiconductor and AI‑related supply‑chain orders and revenue momentum remain intact. As the next‑generation servers roll out, related firms are expected to sustain revenue growth into Q4, with corporate earnings remaining the core support for Taiwan’s mid‑to‑long‑term market trajectory.

As the market moves into an environment of high rates, high valuations and high volatility, the Fed’s rate policy, U.S. Treasury yields and geopolitical impacts on inflation remain the key variables ahead. The Taiwan market is expected to shift from a broad‑based rally to increasing sector and stock‑specific divergence, with capital focusing more on companies that show clear revenue and EPS growth visibility.

On the sector‑allocation side, Allianz Taiwan High‑Yield Growth Active ETF (00984A‑TW) manager Liao Pen‑Long said the current portfolio is weighted most heavily toward financial holding companies to boost diversification and capture fund‑rotation opportunities. The growth tilt spans semiconductor wafer foundries, advanced packaging, memory, IC design, semiconductor equipment, PCBs, industrial PCs and cooling solutions, continuously targeting structural investment opportunities driven by AI and high‑performance computing demand growth.

items.title: 「AI支出義警」時代到來？微軟靠正自由現金流躍居華爾街新寵
items.title_en: Is the Era of “AI‑Spending Vigilantes” Arriving? Microsoft Leaps to Wall Street’s New Darling on Positive Free Cash Flow
paras: 雲端巨頭財報陸續開獎，各項指標顯示，微軟(MSFT-US)的財務狀況優於對手，尤其在亞馬遜(AMZN-US)雲端業務成長未能達到部分投資人預期後，微軟成為大型雲端業者中的贏家。
微軟Azure雲端業務上季營收成長48%，並預估本季成長率將達49%至50%。此外，微軟第3季維持正自由現金流，資本支出也低於原先預期，與競爭對手形成對比。
這使過去一年大部分時間裡在華爾街評價不佳的微軟，如今重新成為大型雲端業者中的領先者。

Azure成長優於預期 微軟雲端地位回升

相較之下，亞馬遜的雲端業務成長未能達到部分投資人的預期。
亞馬遜仍是營收規模最大的雲端業者，上季雲端業務營收達460億美元。亞馬遜網路服務(AWS)單季營收成長39%，高於FactSet訪調分析師預估的37%，但多位分析師在亞馬遜公布財報前指出，機構投資人原本期待的成長率約為43%至44%。
Jefferies交易部分析師Jeffrey Favuzza在給客戶的報告中寫道，亞馬遜的財報讓微軟「看起來更出色」。即使微軟財報後的股價走勢令人失望，也不影響這項判斷。
微軟Azure上季營收達330億美元，營收成長率達48%，高於微軟9月時預估的44%至45%，該公司並預測，本季成長率將進一步升至49%至50%。
Favuzza指出，大型雲端業者目前的「短期排名」似乎由微軟居首，其次依序為Meta Platforms(META-US)、亞馬遜，以及Alphabet(GOOGL-US)。Alphabet才剛創下史上最大單日股價跌幅。

自由現金流成優勢 投資人開始要求AI支出紀律

Carnegie Investment Counsel研究主管Greg Halter指出，微軟另一項突出的優勢是自由現金流。其他三家業者第3季的自由現金流均為負值，代表它們在基礎設施、資料中心及相關採購上的支出，超過本業創造的現金。微軟則維持正自由現金流。
Halter表示：「我們非常重視自由現金流，市場可能正試圖要求這些公司建立支出紀律。」
他提到經濟學家Ed Yardeni提出的著名概念「債券義警」(bond vigilantes)，用來形容不願持有債券、直到殖利率上升並獲得更高報酬才願意進場的投資人。
Halter指出，市場可能正出現「AI支出義警」(AI-spending vigilantes)，投資人正對被認為支出過度、卻未能展現相應回報的企業採取強硬態度。
微軟另一項有利因素是「以更少資源做到更多」。該公司Azure雲端業務成長優於預期，但資本支出，也就是與基礎設施相關的支出，卻比原先預估少了50億美元。
Citizens科技股研究主管Patrick Walravens表示，微軟的AI策略普遍獲得客戶認同。
他說：「隨著AI發展速度愈來愈快，企業最重視的關鍵是信任。在執行長納德拉(Satya Nadella)的領導下，微軟已將信任納入AI策略核心，讓企業能夠執行、管理及部署AI，同時保有對自身資料、模型及智慧財產的控制權。」
paras_en: Cloud giants’ earnings are being released one after another, and the metrics show that Microsoft (MSFT‑US) is in a stronger financial position than its rivals, especially after Amazon’s (AMZN‑US) cloud business growth failed to meet some investors’ expectations, making Microsoft the winner among large cloud providers.

Microsoft Azure’s cloud revenue grew 48% last quarter, and it forecasts this quarter’s growth rate to reach 49%‑50%. In addition, Microsoft maintained positive free cash flow in Q3 and its capital expenditures were lower than originally expected, contrasting with its competitors.
This has turned Microsoft, which received poor Wall Street ratings for most of the past year, back into a leading player among large cloud providers.
Azure growth exceeds expectations, and Microsoft’s cloud position rebounds. By contrast, Amazon’s cloud business growth fell short of some investors’ expectations.

Amazon remains the cloud provider with the largest revenue, posting $46 billion in cloud revenue last quarter. Amazon Web Services (AWS) recorded a 39% quarterly revenue increase, above FactSet analysts’ estimate of 37%, but several analysts noted that institutional investors had originally expected growth of about 43%‑44% before Amazon’s earnings release.

Jefferies trading‑desk analyst Jeffrey Favuzza wrote in a client report that Amazon’s earnings make Microsoft “look better.” Even though Microsoft’s stock reaction after its earnings was disappointing, it does not change that assessment.

Microsoft Azure generated $33 billion in revenue last quarter, a 48% growth rate, higher than Microsoft’s September forecast of 44%‑45%, and the company predicts this quarter’s growth will rise further to 49%‑50%.

Favuzza pointed out that the current “short‑term ranking” among large cloud providers appears to place Microsoft first, followed by Meta Platforms (META‑US), Amazon, and Alphabet (GOOGL‑US). Alphabet has just recorded its biggest single‑day percentage drop in history.

Free cash flow becomes an advantage as investors begin to demand AI‑spending discipline. Carnegie Investment Counsel research head Greg Halter noted that another standout strength for Microsoft is its free cash flow. The other three firms posted negative free cash flow in Q3, meaning their spending on infrastructure, data centers and related purchases exceeded the cash generated by their core operations, whereas Microsoft maintained positive free cash flow.
Halter said, “We place great importance on free cash flow; the market may be trying to force these companies to establish spending discipline.”
He referenced economist Ed Yardeni’s well‑known concept of “bond vigilantes,” used to describe investors who refuse to hold bonds until yields rise and offer higher returns.
Halter suggested the market may be seeing “AI‑spending vigilantes,” with investors taking a hard line against companies perceived to be overspending without delivering commensurate returns.

Another favorable factor for Microsoft is “doing more with fewer resources.” Its Azure cloud growth outperformed expectations, yet capital expenditures—spending related to infrastructure—were $5 billion less than originally forecast.
Citizens Technology equities research head Patrick Walravens said Microsoft’s AI strategy is broadly embraced by customers.

He added, “As AI development accelerates, the key concern for enterprises is trust. Under CEO Satya Nadella’s leadership, Microsoft has made trust central to its AI strategy, enabling companies to execute, manage and deploy AI while retaining control over their data, models and intellectual property.”

items.title: 金居啟動大馬建廠計畫 高階銅箔新廠落腳居林、取得3.12萬坪土地
items.title_en: Jinju Launches Malaysia Plant Project, New High-End Copper Foil Factory to Be Built in Kulim, Acquires 31,200 Ping Land
paras: 2026年挑戰賺回一個股本的銅箔廠金居(8358-TW)，積極擴充高頻、高速銅箔產能以因應市場AI產品的高速需求擴張，金居除雲林三廠2027年逐季開出新產能之外，亦規劃於馬來西亞檳城周邊設立新廠，宣布取得馬國吉打州的居林高科技園區Kulim Hi-Tech Park Phase 4A的土地使用權資產，總面積換算達3.12萬坪。
大馬的吉打州的居林高科技園區(Kulim Hi-Tech Park)區域內科技業者，包括了生產高階載板的AT&S公司及英特爾、英飛凌、富士電機。金居規劃投資馬國新廠占地達3.12萬坪，主要生產HVLP4高頻高速高階應用銅箔，整體規劃產能達年產3萬噸。
金居規劃於馬來西亞居林高科技園區設立新廠，預計分兩期建置，第一批產能將於2028年第三至第四季陸續開出，第二期則規劃於2029年下半年啟動，並以分階段擴充。金居馬來西亞新廠總投資金額初估約80億至100億元，同時，金居也擬在台灣發行可轉換公司債(CB)進行市場籌資支應，預估其發行面額在70億元水準。
金居並規劃於馬來西亞Kulim Hi-Tech Park設立新廠，設定除可供應在馬國設廠的CCL廠台光電(2383-TW)之外，在中南半島的泰國設廠的台燿(6274-TW)、騰輝-KY(6672-TW)及聯茂(6213-TW)也將爲設定客戶對象。
金居對在馬來西亞居林高科技園區投資興建新廠，將以HVLP4為主要生產方向規劃，搭配台灣三廠的高階銅箔產能，形成未來高階產品供應布局。而台灣三廠產能也將逐季開出；隨著AI伺服器及高速傳輸技術持續升級，對低損耗、高性能銅箔的要求同步提高，公司將透過新廠建置及既有產線產品調整，擴大高階銅箔供應能力，支應未來市場需求。
paras_en: In 2026, Jinju (8358-TW), a copper foil plant aiming to earn back one share capital, is actively expanding high‑frequency, high‑speed copper foil capacity to meet the rapid growth of AI product demand. Besides rolling out new capacity at its three Yunlin factories quarter by quarter in 2027, Jinju also plans to set up a new plant near Penang, Malaysia, announcing that it has secured land‑use rights in Phase 4A of the Kulim Hi‑Tech Park in Kedah, Malaysia, amounting to a total of about 31,200 ping.

Kedah’s Kulim Hi‑Tech Park hosts technology companies such as AT&S, which produces high‑end substrates, as well as Intel, Infineon and Fuji Electric. Jinju plans to invest in a new Malaysian plant covering 31,200 ping, primarily to produce HVLP4 high‑frequency, high‑speed, high‑end application copper foil, with an overall design capacity of 30,000 tonnes per year.

Jinju intends to build the new plant in Kulim Hi‑Tech Park in two phases. The first batch of capacity is expected to come online gradually in the third to fourth quarters of 2028, while the second phase is slated to start in the second half of 2029 with staged expansions. The total investment for the Malaysian plant is initially estimated at NT$8‑10 billion, and Jinju also plans to issue convertible bonds (CB) in Taiwan to raise funds, with an anticipated issuance amount of around NT$7 billion.

Jinju’s plan for the new plant in Malaysia’s Kulim Hi‑Tech Park includes serving not only CCL’s Taiwan Semiconductor (2383‑TW), which has a plant in Malaysia, but also other regional customers such as Taiwan’s Tai Yao (6274‑TW) in Thailand, Teng‑Hui‑KY (6672‑TW) and Lian‑Mao (6213‑TW).

Jinju’s investment in a new plant at Kulim Hi‑Tech Park will focus on HVLP4 production, complementing the high‑end copper foil capacity of its three Taiwanese factories to create a future supply network for premium products. As the three Taiwanese plants ramp up capacity quarter by quarter, the ongoing upgrades in AI servers and high‑speed transmission technologies are driving higher demand for low‑loss, high‑performance copper foil. The company will expand its high‑end copper foil supply capability through the new plant and adjustments to existing lines to meet future market needs.

items.title: AI 算力撞上傳輸天花板！PCB、CCL 材料迎「混種革命」，揭密下一波千億升級商機
items.title_en: AI Computing Power Hits the Transmission Ceiling! PCB and CCL Materials Embrace a "Hybrid Revolution", Unveiling the Next Trillion‑Dollar Upgrade Opportunity
paras: AI 算力狂飆使傳輸極限提早報到，電路板產業正全面跨入系統級半導體化整合，從 M10 基材、石英布到玻璃核心載板，材料與工藝走向「混合化革新」，高階產能稀缺確立長線多頭，下一波千億升級商機已蓄勢待發。
〈M10等級基材問世，石英布與RCC方案分歧競逐〉

paras_en: The surge in AI computing power is pushing transmission limits ahead of schedule, and the circuit board industry is fully moving toward system‑level semiconductor integration. From M10 substrates and quartz fabrics to glass‑core substrates, materials and processes are shifting toward "hybrid innovation," making high‑end capacity scarce and establishing a long‑term bullish outlook, with the next trillion‑dollar upgrade opportunity poised to emerge.
M10‑grade substrates debut, quartz fabric and RCC solutions vie for market share.

Under the material upgrade framework, high‑frequency, high‑speed CCL officially enters the new M10 era. To achieve extreme low loss and high reliability, leading manufacturers are adopting solutions such as quartz glass fabric (Q‑Glass), PTFE resin formulations, and non‑glass‑fiber back‑bonded copper foils (RCC/ZRCC) to lower Dk/Df and boost dielectric strength. Meanwhile, server motherboards, constrained by line‑density and layer‑count miniaturization, are accelerating the adoption of high‑layer count (HLC) boards combined with high‑density interconnect (HDI) hybrid designs, even extending to semi‑additive (mSAP) type substrate processes, breaking the physical transmission limits of traditional circuit boards.
Core substrate architecture upgrades, high‑end materials in tight demand, testing process yields.

As advanced‑package chip sizes continue to expand, IC substrate structures face severe rigidity and warp‑control challenges, driving multilayer core (MLC), glass‑core, and ceramic substrates into the spotlight. Premium raw materials such as high‑grade glass fiber fabrics, ultra‑low‑profile copper foils (HVLP4/5), and wear‑resistant precision drill bits are under constant supply pressure, giving material suppliers with cost‑pass‑through ability greater bargaining power. At the same time, board makers are heavily tested on yield control for thick‑board lamination and precise alignment, highlighting the scarce value of high‑end capacity.

items.title: 伊朗最高領袖下令軍方備戰！更新美以打擊目標、警告威脅來襲立即反擊
items.title_en: Iran's Supreme Leader Orders the Military to Prepare for War! Updates US‑Israel Strike Targets, Warns Threats Will Be Countered Immediately
paras: 伊朗最高領袖穆吉塔巴（Mojtaba Khamenei）已指示軍方高層，為可能再度與美國、以色列爆發軍事衝突做好準備，並要求擴大報復選項，對未來任何威脅立即採取回應。
根據《Investing.com》報導，穆吉塔巴週六（31日）透過 Telegram 發表聲明，要求伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊、陸軍及武裝部隊總參謀部更新潛在打擊目標清單，將美國及以色列資產納入伊朗軍方的打擊範圍。
此外，他也要求透過運用新技術強化軍事能力，並為衝突可能升級做好軍事準備。
穆吉塔巴表示，無論威脅發生在何種地理位置，都應立即採取有效回應。聲明並未說明他與軍方指揮官會面的時間及地點。自美國與以色列今年2月對伊朗展開軍事行動以來，穆吉塔巴便未曾公開露面。
與此同時，伊朗國營電視台IRIB引述荷姆茲甘省（Hormozgan）官員報導，美軍據稱在格什姆島（Qeshm Island）附近攻擊兩艘漁船，造成兩名漁民失蹤、另有一人受傷。不過，美國政府尚未立即證實這起事件。
伊朗軍方備戰動向，與美伊持續透過外交管道尋求結束這場已延續8個月的衝突形成對比。
巴基斯坦軍方發言人喬杜里（Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry）週五（30日）接受《路透》獨家專訪時表示，對於斡旋美伊談判仍抱持「審慎樂觀」態度，並指出巴基斯坦陸軍元帥穆尼爾（Asim Munir）近期訪問德黑蘭後，談判已出現正面進展。
美國總統川普週五也表示，預期戰爭很快就會結束。他接受堪薩斯城廣播電台KCMO訪問時稱，衝突將「很快落幕」，但再次強調，美國必須取得保證，確保伊朗永遠不會發展核武。
另一方面，《華爾街日報》報導，華府已警告波斯灣國家，應為11月3日美國期中選舉後可能再度發動攻擊做好準備。
《福斯新聞》（Fox News）則另報導稱，美國中央司令部已向川普簡報可能採取的軍事行動選項。
paras_en: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei has instructed senior military officials to prepare for a possible renewed military clash with the United States and Israel, and has called for an expansion of retaliation options to respond immediately to any future threat.

According to Investing.com, Khamenei issued a statement via Telegram on Saturday (the 31st), demanding that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, the army and the General Staff of the armed forces update their list of potential strike targets to include U.S. and Israeli assets within Iran's strike range.
He also ordered the use of new technologies to strengthen military capabilities and to ready the forces for a possible escalation of the conflict.

Khamenei said that regardless of where a threat originates, an effective response must be taken without delay. The statement did not specify the time or place of his meeting with military commanders. Since the U.S. and Israel launched military actions against Iran in February of this year, Khamenei has not appeared publicly.

At the same time, Iran's state broadcaster IRIB, citing officials from Hormozgan province, reported that U.S. forces allegedly attacked two fishing boats near Qeshm Island, resulting in two fishermen missing and one injured. The U.S. government has not immediately confirmed the incident.
The Iranian military's readiness moves contrast with ongoing diplomatic efforts by the United States and Iran to end the eight‑month‑long conflict.

Pakistani military spokesman Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry told Reuters in an exclusive interview on Friday (the 30th) that he remains "cautiously optimistic" about mediating U.S.–Iran talks, noting that after Pakistani Army Chief Asim Munir's recent visit to Tehran, negotiations have shown positive progress.

U.S. President Donald Trump also said on Friday that he expects the war to end soon. In an interview with Kansas City radio station KCMO, he said the conflict will "wrap up quickly," but reiterated that the United States must obtain guarantees that Iran will never develop nuclear weapons.
Meanwhile, the Wall Street Journal reported that Washington has warned Gulf states to prepare for a possible renewed attack after the U.S. midterm elections on November 3.
Fox News reported that the U.S. Central Command has briefed Trump on possible military action options.

items.title: 高通膨與高殖利率拉鋸！PIMCO解析Fed：12月升息1碼機率高 長期維持高利率
items.title_en: High Inflation and High Yields Tug-of-War! PIMCO Analyzes Fed: High Probability of a 25‑bp Rate Hike in December, Long‑Term High Rates Expected
paras: 聯準會10月會議將政策利率維持在3.75%–4.0%不變，暫緩升息以評估緊縮效果，但仍保留緊縮傾向。PIMCO分析指出，此舉屬政策重新校準而非長期升息循環開端，預期12月將再升息1碼，2027年初不排除再升1碼。主席華許強調金融環境收緊且通膨預期穩定。另外，聯準會規劃自2027年秋季起調整會議時程，將轉為每年6次政策會議與2次策略會議。

美聯準會10月暫緩升息 PIMCO預估12月再升息1碼 政策仍處重新校準

美聯聯準會在10月會議決議將政策利率維持在3.75%–4.0%不變，在9月升息25個基點（1碼）後暫停升息，但官方仍維持明確的緊縮傾向。權威債券投資機構PIMCO（品浩）最新發布分析指出，聯準會暫停升息並非長期升息循環的開端，而是政策的重新校準，預期12月將再升息25個基點，且2027年初仍存在再升息1次的風險，隨後利率可能維持較長時間不變。

金融情勢收緊 華許稱藥效已開始發揮

對於市場關注在經濟成長強勁、通膨仍高之際為何選擇等待，聯準會主席華許（Kevin Warsh）表示，官員希望爭取時間評估9月升息與整體金融環境收緊的影響。多數委員認為，過去的緊縮措施藥效已開始發揮作用。
PIMCO指出，2026年以來美國長天期公債殖利率明顯上升，大幅推高企業與消費者借貸成本，抵銷了股市強勁帶來的經濟支撐。同時，CCC評級等低品質借款人信用利差擴大，高資本支出的AI產業鏈亦受影響，顯示高利率對科技投資敏感度極高，給予決策官員暫緩連續升息的空間。

投票結果現分歧 12月仍有重啟升息壓力

儘管暫停升息，美內需與資本投資仍具韌性，通膨則呈橫向發展，決策官員對高於2%目標的通膨風險始終保持警戒。聲明強調「累積更多資訊」將有助於判斷後續政策。10月決議以10比2通過，其中理事Lisa Cook與克里夫蘭聯準銀行總裁Beth Hammack主張應再升息25個基點，顯見內部對緊縮步調仍有不同看法。
PIMCO強調，目前與2022年的全面過熱情境不同，薪資成長與單位勞動成本已放緩，加上生產力維持強勁，讓官員能以更審慎漸進的方式回應。然而，長天期殖利率近期上升主要源於市場對政策利率預期提高，若聯準會未能在未來會議實現市場已反映的升息預期，金融環境恐重新寬鬆並使通膨居高不下。

2027年起會議時程大改 聚焦策略討論

華許同時說明了聯準會未來的會議制度調整。每年8次會議的總數不變，但自2027年秋季起，其中1次會議將專門用於討論貨幣政策策略而不進行政策表決；到了2028年，將正式定案為6次政策會議搭配2次無表決的策略會議。
PIMCO總結，進入2027年後若通膨降溫更顯著且借貸成本進一步拖累經濟，繼續升息的必要性將降低，藥效或許已發揮作用，但聯準會尚未宣布療程結束。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve kept its policy rate unchanged at 3.75%‑4.0% at the October meeting, pausing hikes to assess the tightening effect but still retaining a tightening bias. PIMCO analysis says this is a policy recalibration rather than the start of a long‑term hiking cycle, and it expects another 25‑basis‑point increase in December, with a possible additional hike in early 2027. Chair Kevin Warsh emphasized that the financial environment is tightening and inflation expectations are stable. The Fed also plans to adjust its meeting schedule from fall 2027, moving to six policy meetings and two strategy meetings each year.

The Fed’s October meeting left the policy rate unchanged at 3.75%‑4.0% after a 25‑bp hike in September, pausing further increases while maintaining a clear tightening stance. Leading bond‑investment firm PIMCO noted that the pause is not the beginning of a prolonged hiking cycle but a policy recalibration, forecasting another 25‑bp hike in December and a risk of one more hike in early 2027, after which rates could stay elevated for an extended period.

Regarding market questions about why the Fed is waiting despite strong growth and still‑high inflation, Chair Kevin Warsh said officials want time to evaluate the impact of the September hike and the overall tightening of financial conditions. Most committee members believe the effects of past tightening measures have begun to materialize.

PIMCO points out that since 2026 U.S. long‑term Treasury yields have risen sharply, pushing up borrowing costs for corporations and consumers and offsetting the economic support from a strong equity market. At the same time, credit spreads for low‑quality borrowers such as CCC‑rated issuers have widened, and the high‑capital‑intensive AI supply chain is also feeling the strain, showing that high rates are especially painful for tech investment and giving policymakers room to pause consecutive hikes.

Even with the pause, domestic demand and capital investment remain resilient while inflation is moving sideways, keeping officials on guard against inflation above the 2% target. The statement stressed that “accumulating more information” will aid future policy judgments. The October decision passed 10‑2, with Board member Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack arguing for another 25‑bp hike, highlighting internal disagreement on the tightening pace.

PIMCO emphasizes that the current environment differs from the fully overheated scenario of 2022: wage growth and unit labor costs have slowed, while productivity remains strong, allowing officials to respond more cautiously and incrementally. However, the recent rise in long‑term yields is mainly driven by market expectations of higher policy rates; if the Fed fails to deliver the hikes the market has already priced in, financial conditions could loosen again and keep inflation elevated.

Warsh also explained the Fed’s upcoming meeting‑schedule changes. The total of eight meetings per year stays the same, but starting in fall 2027 one meeting will be dedicated solely to monetary‑policy strategy without a policy vote; by 2028 the format will be formalized as six policy meetings plus two non‑voting strategy meetings.

PIMCO concludes that after 2027, if inflation cools more markedly and borrowing costs further drag on the economy, the need for additional hikes will diminish. The tightening effect may already be taking hold, but the Fed has not yet announced the end of the “treatment.”

items.title: 中東緊張局勢再起 黃金為何仍暴跌至一年來最低價？
items.title_en: Middle East Tensions Resurge: Why Is Gold Still Plummeting to Its Lowest Level in a Year?
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，避險資產黃金週五(30日)重挫，跌至一年來最低，這似乎與美國期中選舉週二結束後，中東可能再度陷入動盪的緊張情勢背道而馳。
過去一段時間，當地區衝突或國家間戰爭看似即將爆發，或可能進一步升級時，投資人往往會轉向黃金、美國公債與美元等避險資產。但在美國總統川普第二任期內，許多傳統避險模式已經出現反轉。
推動美股長達四年牛市的科技股漲勢，以及市場可能出現的劇烈反轉，如今似乎也正在改變過去投資人避險的行為模式。
American Gold Exchange總裁Dana Samuelson表示，截至週五，股市大幅拋售下「因資金流動性驅動的避險需求，對貴金屬市場造成附帶傷害」。換言之，投資人在股市遭受損失後急於取得現金，而出售黃金成為籌措資金的方式之一。
根據道瓊市場數據，黃金週五在紐約商品交易所（Comex）收於每盎司3,898.90美元，12月期貨合約當天下跌3.3%。10月以來，金價累計下跌10%，創下2025年10月2日以來最低。
Samuelson表示，股市拋售之際，黃金市場本身已經處於「疲弱且脆弱」狀態，金價當時僅略高於7月形成的重要支撐價位3,975美元。一旦金價跌破這項技術支撐，便進一步加劇跌勢。
美股主要指數週五普遍走低，道瓊工業指數收跌1.1%，標普500指數重挫1.8%，那斯達克綜合指數跌幅最大，下跌2.9%。
期貨經紀商Altavest共同創辦人兼管理合夥人Michael Armbruster表示，「當股市大幅下跌時，人們就會尋求流動性。」
不過，American Gold Exchange的Samuelson表示，整體市場似乎已經「提前反映日益升高的擔憂」，也就是波斯灣地區最快可能在下週出現重大且足以造成局勢動盪的軍事升級。
川普近期的言論確實值得關注。本月稍早，他在社群媒體發文表示，美國不會在11月3日美國大選前對伊朗採取軍事行動，但媒體報導指出，相關方面已擬定重大打擊計畫。
XS.com資深市場分析師Samer Hasn表示，儘管中東局勢升級的風險高漲，且近期可能再度爆發區域戰爭，黃金仍持續承受賣壓，也難以維持較大幅度的反彈。
他在週五的評論中指出，這是因為中東局勢惡化，加上美國經濟展現韌性，可能促使聯準會(Fed)維持「利率在較長時間內居高不下」政策，使美國公債殖利率維持高檔，進而阻礙金價持續復甦。
U.S. Bank Asset Management資深投資策略師Rob Haworth表示，「在科技業財報大致符合預期，以及AI產業賣壓逐漸擴大的背景下，市場最新浮現的消息是成長疑慮。」
他指出，如果AI產業賣壓進一步加劇，尤其是選舉結果顯示民眾反對資料中心擴建，黃金可能因此獲得一些支撐。
從較長期來看，Altavest的Armbruster認為，金價可能進一步走高，尤其是如果聯準會在2027年傾向降息。
他表示，黃金與股市同步下跌的情況，令人聯想到2008年金融危機。當年金價在10月觸底，隨後三年內上漲逾250%。
Armbruster指出，美國政府若要持續為國債融資，就需要大量印鈔。長期來看，這「對黃金極為有利」。他並補充，Altavest已建議看好黃金的投資人「暫時保留資金，等到年底再觀察」。
他最後表示，「現在還不要逢低買進。」
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that the safe‑haven asset gold suffered a sharp drop on Friday (the 30th), sinking to its lowest level in a year, a move that seems at odds with the heightened tension that could see the Middle East plunge back into turmoil after the U.S. mid‑term elections concluded on Tuesday.

In recent periods, when regional conflicts or wars between nations appeared imminent or could potentially escalate, investors typically turned to gold, U.S. Treasury bonds and the dollar as safe‑haven assets. Yet during President Trump’s second term, many traditional safe‑haven patterns have reversed.
The tech‑driven four‑year bull market in U.S. equities and the possibility of a dramatic market reversal now appear to be reshaping investors’ hedging behavior.

Dana Samuelson, president of American Gold Exchange, said that as of Friday, the massive sell‑off in equities created “liquidity‑driven hedging demand that inflicted collateral damage on the precious‑metals market.” In other words, investors, having lost money in stocks, rushed for cash, and selling gold became one way to raise funds.

According to Dow Jones market data, gold closed on Friday on the New York Commodity Exchange (Comex) at $3,898.90 per ounce, with the December futures contract down 3.3% that day. Since October, the price has fallen 10%, hitting its lowest point since October 2, 2025.

Samuelson added that amid the equity sell‑off, the gold market was already “weak and fragile,” with prices only slightly above the key July support level of $3,975. A break below that technical support would likely accelerate the decline.
Major U.S. equity indexes fell across the board on Friday: the Dow Jones Industrial Average slipped 1.1%, the S&P 500 dropped 1.8%, and the Nasdaq Composite posted the biggest loss, falling 2.9%.
Michael Armbruster, co‑founder and managing partner of futures broker Altavest, said, “When the stock market falls sharply, people look for liquidity.”

However, Samuelson of American Gold Exchange noted that the broader market seems to have “pre‑emptively priced in rising concerns,” referring to the possibility of a major military escalation in the Persian Gulf region as early as next week that could destabilize the situation.

Trump’s recent remarks have drawn attention. Earlier this month he posted on social media that the United States would not take military action against Iran before the November 3 U.S. election, though media reports say that plans for a significant strike have already been drafted.

Samer Hasn, senior market analyst at XS.com, said that despite the heightened risk of an escalating Middle‑East crisis and the chance of a renewed regional war, gold continues to face selling pressure and is unlikely to mount a sizable rebound.

In his Friday commentary he explained that worsening Middle‑East tensions combined with a resilient U.S. economy could prompt the Federal Reserve to keep “interest rates high for an extended period,” keeping Treasury yields elevated and hampering any sustained gold recovery.

Rob Haworth, senior investment strategist at U.S. Bank Asset Management, said, “With tech earnings roughly meeting expectations and AI‑sector selling pressure gradually expanding, the latest market narrative is one of growth concerns.”
He added that if AI‑related selling intensifies, especially if election outcomes show public opposition to data‑center expansion, gold could receive some support as a result.
Looking further ahead, Armbruster of Altavest believes gold could rise further, particularly if the Fed leans toward rate cuts in 2027.
He noted that gold’s simultaneous decline with equities evokes memories of the 2008 financial crisis, when gold bottomed in October and then surged more than 250% over the next three years.

Armbruster pointed out that for the U.S. government to keep financing its debt it will need to print large amounts of money, a scenario that is “extremely favorable for gold” in the long run. He added that Altavest has advised investors bullish on gold to “hold funds for now and reassess at year‑end.”
He concluded, “Now is not the time to buy on dips.”

items.title: 美股亂流引發台股賣壓 法人仍看好中長期基本面支撐、留意個股分化趨勢
items.title_en: U.S. Market Turbulence Triggers Selling Pressure on Taiwan Stocks; Institutions Remain Bullish on Mid‑to‑Long‑Term Fundamentals and Watch for Stock‑Specific Divergence
paras: 受美股科技股震盪與財報雜音干擾，台股近期賣壓增溫，指數劇烈波動並反覆測試底部。法人指出，雖然短線市場情緒趨於保守，致使部分亮眼財報面臨獲利了結賣壓；但從中長期來看，美國雲端巨頭AI資本支出未減，台灣半導體與科技供應鏈的關鍵地位依舊穩固。在評價與高波動並存的環境下，拉回反倒提供了中長線分批布局與多元配置的良機。
針對近期盤勢，安聯台灣大壩基金暨安聯台灣科技基金經理人蕭惠中表示，國際情勢、利率走勢、聯準會政策預期與AI投資疑慮等雜音持續干擾市場，導致短期投資情緒凌駕基本面，資金動能轉趨保守。即使部分企業繳出亮眼財報，仍面臨獲利了結賣壓，致使台股短線波動明顯放大。
蕭惠中指出，雖然短線市場將反覆測試底部，但台灣科技產業的基本面並未出現轉折。美國大型雲端服務業者持續擴大AI資本支出，雲端及先進運算需求維持強勁成長，且半導體與AI相關供應鏈訂單、營收動能無虞。隨著新一代伺服器逐步出貨，相關企業第四季營收可望延續成長力道，企業獲利仍是支撐台股中長期走勢的核心基石。
隨著市場進入高利率、高評價與高波動並存的環境，聯準會利率政策、美債殖利率及地緣政治對通膨的影響仍是後續主要變數。預期台股行情將由過去的全面齊漲，逐步轉向產業與個股分化，資金將更聚焦於營收及EPS成長能見度高的企業。
在產業配置方面，安聯台灣高息成長主動式ETF(00984A-TW)經理人廖本隆指出，目前投資組合以金融控股為最大產業配置，藉此提升持股多元性，並掌握市場資金輪動機會；成長布局則廣泛涵蓋半導體晶圓代工、先進封裝、記憶體、IC設計、半導體設備、PCB、工業電腦及散熱等科技供應鏈，持續掌握AI與高效能運算需求成長所帶動的結構性投資機會。
paras_en: The recent sell‑off in Taiwan equities has intensified as U.S. tech stocks wobble and earnings noise creates interference, causing the index to swing wildly and repeatedly test its lows. Institutions note that while short‑term market sentiment has become cautious—leading to profit‑taking pressure on some standout earnings—the mid‑to‑long‑term outlook remains solid: U.S. cloud giants continue robust AI capital spending and Taiwan’s semiconductor and tech supply chain retains its pivotal role. In a setting of high valuations and volatility, the pullback actually offers a good chance for phased, diversified positioning over the medium to long term.

Regarding the latest market action, Allianz Taiwan Dam Fund and Allianz Taiwan Tech Fund manager Hsu Hui‑Chung said that international developments, interest‑rate trends, Fed policy expectations and AI‑investment concerns continue to cloud the market, causing short‑term sentiment to outweigh fundamentals and capital flows to become more conservative. Even companies delivering impressive earnings face profit‑taking pressure, amplifying short‑term volatility in Taiwan stocks.

Hsu pointed out that although the short‑term market will keep testing the bottom, the fundamentals of Taiwan’s tech industry have not turned. Major U.S. cloud service providers are still expanding AI capital expenditures, keeping demand for cloud and high‑performance computing strong, and semiconductor and AI‑related supply‑chain orders and revenue momentum remain intact. As the next‑generation servers roll out, related firms are expected to sustain revenue growth into Q4, with corporate earnings remaining the core support for Taiwan’s mid‑to‑long‑term market trajectory.

As the market moves into an environment of high rates, high valuations and high volatility, the Fed’s rate policy, U.S. Treasury yields and geopolitical impacts on inflation remain the key variables ahead. The Taiwan market is expected to shift from a broad‑based rally to increasing sector and stock‑specific divergence, with capital focusing more on companies that show clear revenue and EPS growth visibility.

On the sector‑allocation side, Allianz Taiwan High‑Yield Growth Active ETF (00984A‑TW) manager Liao Pen‑Long said the current portfolio is weighted most heavily toward financial holding companies to boost diversification and capture fund‑rotation opportunities. The growth tilt spans semiconductor wafer foundries, advanced packaging, memory, IC design, semiconductor equipment, PCBs, industrial PCs and cooling solutions, continuously targeting structural investment opportunities driven by AI and high‑performance computing demand growth.

items.title: 金居啟動大馬建廠計畫 高階銅箔新廠落腳居林、取得3.12萬坪土地
items.title_en: Jinju Launches Malaysia Plant Project, New High-End Copper Foil Factory to Be Built in Kulim, Acquires 31,200 Ping Land
paras: 2026年挑戰賺回一個股本的銅箔廠金居(8358-TW)，積極擴充高頻、高速銅箔產能以因應市場AI產品的高速需求擴張，金居除雲林三廠2027年逐季開出新產能之外，亦規劃於馬來西亞檳城周邊設立新廠，宣布取得馬國吉打州的居林高科技園區Kulim Hi-Tech Park Phase 4A的土地使用權資產，總面積換算達3.12萬坪。
大馬的吉打州的居林高科技園區(Kulim Hi-Tech Park)區域內科技業者，包括了生產高階載板的AT&S公司及英特爾、英飛凌、富士電機。金居規劃投資馬國新廠占地達3.12萬坪，主要生產HVLP4高頻高速高階應用銅箔，整體規劃產能達年產3萬噸。
金居規劃於馬來西亞居林高科技園區設立新廠，預計分兩期建置，第一批產能將於2028年第三至第四季陸續開出，第二期則規劃於2029年下半年啟動，並以分階段擴充。金居馬來西亞新廠總投資金額初估約80億至100億元，同時，金居也擬在台灣發行可轉換公司債(CB)進行市場籌資支應，預估其發行面額在70億元水準。
金居並規劃於馬來西亞Kulim Hi-Tech Park設立新廠，設定除可供應在馬國設廠的CCL廠台光電(2383-TW)之外，在中南半島的泰國設廠的台燿(6274-TW)、騰輝-KY(6672-TW)及聯茂(6213-TW)也將爲設定客戶對象。
金居對在馬來西亞居林高科技園區投資興建新廠，將以HVLP4為主要生產方向規劃，搭配台灣三廠的高階銅箔產能，形成未來高階產品供應布局。而台灣三廠產能也將逐季開出；隨著AI伺服器及高速傳輸技術持續升級，對低損耗、高性能銅箔的要求同步提高，公司將透過新廠建置及既有產線產品調整，擴大高階銅箔供應能力，支應未來市場需求。
paras_en: In 2026, Jinju (8358-TW), a copper foil plant aiming to earn back one share capital, is actively expanding high‑frequency, high‑speed copper foil capacity to meet the rapid growth of AI product demand. Besides rolling out new capacity at its three Yunlin factories quarter by quarter in 2027, Jinju also plans to set up a new plant near Penang, Malaysia, announcing that it has secured land‑use rights in Phase 4A of the Kulim Hi‑Tech Park in Kedah, Malaysia, amounting to a total of about 31,200 ping.

Kedah’s Kulim Hi‑Tech Park hosts technology companies such as AT&S, which produces high‑end substrates, as well as Intel, Infineon and Fuji Electric. Jinju plans to invest in a new Malaysian plant covering 31,200 ping, primarily to produce HVLP4 high‑frequency, high‑speed, high‑end application copper foil, with an overall design capacity of 30,000 tonnes per year.

Jinju intends to build the new plant in Kulim Hi‑Tech Park in two phases. The first batch of capacity is expected to come online gradually in the third to fourth quarters of 2028, while the second phase is slated to start in the second half of 2029 with staged expansions. The total investment for the Malaysian plant is initially estimated at NT$8‑10 billion, and Jinju also plans to issue convertible bonds (CB) in Taiwan to raise funds, with an anticipated issuance amount of around NT$7 billion.

Jinju’s plan for the new plant in Malaysia’s Kulim Hi‑Tech Park includes serving not only CCL’s Taiwan Semiconductor (2383‑TW), which has a plant in Malaysia, but also other regional customers such as Taiwan’s Tai Yao (6274‑TW) in Thailand, Teng‑Hui‑KY (6672‑TW) and Lian‑Mao (6213‑TW).

Jinju’s investment in a new plant at Kulim Hi‑Tech Park will focus on HVLP4 production, complementing the high‑end copper foil capacity of its three Taiwanese factories to create a future supply network for premium products. As the three Taiwanese plants ramp up capacity quarter by quarter, the ongoing upgrades in AI servers and high‑speed transmission technologies are driving higher demand for low‑loss, high‑performance copper foil. The company will expand its high‑end copper foil supply capability through the new plant and adjustments to existing lines to meet future market needs.

paras_en: The surge in AI computing power is pushing transmission limits ahead of schedule, and the circuit board industry is fully moving toward system‑level semiconductor integration. From M10 substrates and quartz fabrics to glass‑core substrates, materials and processes are shifting toward "hybrid innovation," making high‑end capacity scarce and establishing a long‑term bullish outlook, with the next trillion‑dollar upgrade opportunity poised to emerge.
M10‑grade substrates debut, quartz fabric and RCC solutions vie for market share.

Under the material upgrade framework, high‑frequency, high‑speed CCL officially enters the new M10 era. To achieve extreme low loss and high reliability, leading manufacturers are adopting solutions such as quartz glass fabric (Q‑Glass), PTFE resin formulations, and non‑glass‑fiber back‑bonded copper foils (RCC/ZRCC) to lower Dk/Df and boost dielectric strength. Meanwhile, server motherboards, constrained by line‑density and layer‑count miniaturization, are accelerating the adoption of high‑layer count (HLC) boards combined with high‑density interconnect (HDI) hybrid designs, even extending to semi‑additive (mSAP) type substrate processes, breaking the physical transmission limits of traditional circuit boards.
Core substrate architecture upgrades, high‑end materials in tight demand, testing process yields.

As advanced‑package chip sizes continue to expand, IC substrate structures face severe rigidity and warp‑control challenges, driving multilayer core (MLC), glass‑core, and ceramic substrates into the spotlight. Premium raw materials such as high‑grade glass fiber fabrics, ultra‑low‑profile copper foils (HVLP4/5), and wear‑resistant precision drill bits are under constant supply pressure, giving material suppliers with cost‑pass‑through ability greater bargaining power. At the same time, board makers are heavily tested on yield control for thick‑board lamination and precise alignment, highlighting the scarce value of high‑end capacity.

paras: 伺服器龐大需求持續引爆，電腦品牌大廠華碩(2357-TW)與技嘉(2376-TW)近期接連啟動大規模籌資計畫，合計籌集資金規模突破千億元。雙雄積極布局資金調度與資本支出，主要用於擴增伺服器廠房設備、原物料採購及海外營運週轉，全面搶攻明年度新世代算力平台的龐大商機。
華碩受惠伺服器與個人電腦拉貨暢旺，宣布將今年全年度伺服器業務營收成長目標，由原先預期的100%大幅上修至150%。技嘉方面同步展現強勁動能，除將全年度資本支出規模由23億至25億元上修至28億至30億元，更在日前簽訂總額達500億元的聯合授信合約，全力支應擴建新廠及購料資金。
在籌資策略方面，華碩董事會通過發行15億美元海外無擔保可轉換公司債，並以持有的研華股權發行10億美元海外無擔保交換公司債，合計發債募資約25億美元。華碩新加坡全資子公司隨後更完成首筆20億美元海外聯合授信案，在參貸行超額認購下自10億美元倍增至20億美元，為集團成立以來規模最大的海外融資案。
技嘉則由董事會決議通過與臺灣銀行、兆豐銀行、華南銀行及國泰世華銀行等銀行團簽約，簽署總額500億元、為期5年的聯合授信案。技嘉此次募資以償還金融機構借款並充實中期營運週轉金為主，針對明年新一代運算平台的零組件採購與備貨需求，提前完成資金佈署。
產能與訂單結構方面，華碩上半年伺服器出貨以HGX架構與GB300 NVL72機櫃為主力，兩者合計占整體伺服器營收高達90%，因接單動能強勁且供貨不及，促使公司積極擴大資源投放。技嘉則透過調升資本支出，將資金投入購置新辦公大樓、擴增AI伺服器廠房產能及添購機器設備，產品線順利由HGX銜接至GB300。
技嘉現階段已開始少量交付搭載NVIDIA新一代Vera Rubin架構的相關產品，預計明年上半年在客戶驗證完畢後逐步放量出貨。華碩除了在機櫃級伺服器持續擴大出貨，第四季也推出以RTX Spark打造的新世代個人電腦與筆電，首批通路訂單已全數售罄，積極向下延伸端點運算布局。
paras_en: The huge demand for servers continues to explode, prompting major PC brands Asus (2357‑TW) and Gigabyte (2376‑TW) to launch large‑scale fundraising plans in recent weeks, raising a combined total of over NT$100 billion. The two giants are actively arranging financing and capital expenditures, primarily to expand server plant equipment, purchase raw materials, and fund overseas operations, aiming to capture the massive market opportunity of next‑generation compute platforms next year.

Benefiting from a surge in server and personal computer orders, Asus announced that it has dramatically raised its full‑year server revenue growth target from the previously expected 100% to 150%. Gigabyte likewise showed strong momentum, increasing its full‑year capital expenditure outlook from NT$23‑25 billion to NT$28‑30 billion, and recently signing a joint credit agreement worth NT$500 billion to fully support new plant construction and material purchases.

Regarding fundraising strategy, Asus’s board approved the issuance of US$1.5 billion of overseas unsecured convertible bonds and, using its stake in Advantech, an additional US$1 billion of overseas unsecured exchangeable bonds, totaling roughly US$2.5 billion in bond proceeds. Asus’s wholly‑owned Singapore subsidiary then completed its first overseas syndicated loan of US$2 billion, which was oversubscribed by participating banks and doubled from the original US$1 billion request, becoming the largest overseas financing ever for the group.

Gigabyte’s board resolved to sign a five‑year, NT$500 billion joint credit facility with a consortium of banks including Bank of Taiwan, Mega International Commercial Bank, Hua Nan Bank and Cathay United Bank. The fundraising will mainly be used to repay existing bank loans and bolster mid‑term working capital, while also pre‑funding component purchases and inventory for next year’s new‑generation computing platforms.

In terms of capacity and order mix, Asus’s server shipments in the first half of the year were dominated by the HGX architecture and the GB300 NVL72 rack, together accounting for about 90% of total server revenue. Strong order momentum and supply constraints have driven the company to further increase resource allocation. Gigabyte, by raising its capital spending, is investing in a new office building, expanding AI server plant capacity, and acquiring additional machinery, smoothly transitioning its product line from HGX to GB300.

Gigabyte has already begun delivering a limited volume of products equipped with NVIDIA’s next‑generation Vera Rubin architecture, with plans to ramp up shipments in the first half of next year after customer validation. Asus continues to expand shipments of rack‑level servers and, in Q4, launched a new generation of PCs and laptops built on RTX Spark; the first batch of channel orders sold out completely, reinforcing its push into edge‑computing deployments.

items.title: jpp-KY深耕泰國舉辦自動化比賽 獲皇室肯定御賜獎盃
items.title_en: jpp-KY Deepens Roots in Thailand Hosting Automation Competition, Receives Royal Trophy
paras: 泰國精密鈑金領導廠商jpp-KY經寶精密(5284-TW)為延攬更多人才並加強產學合作，祭出逾70萬泰銖獎金，主辦2026 JINPAO-PRAKSA 自動化競賽決賽，今年泰國皇室詩琳通公主更御賜獎盃加持，是泰國社會對經寶推動人才培育的最高肯定。
經寶精密董事長鍾國松表示，深耕泰國多年，不只是投資建廠，更希望透過企業累積的工業技術，積極為泰國青年學子搭建一個驗證課堂所學、解決真實工程問題的舞台。
鍾國松認為，自動化與機器人技術是未來工業發展的重要基礎，期待競賽讓學生在真實任務中發揮創意、驗證設計，並逐步具備進入專業領域所需的實作經驗。
「2026年JINPAO-PRAKSA自動化競賽」(中學及職業教育組工業自動化與機器人競賽)決賽，於10月30日至31日在帕克薩國際教育學校(Praksa Withedsuksa School)舉行。來自泰國26府、共43支隊伍參與，最終16支隊伍進入決賽，透過三輪實作競賽來角逐御賜獎盃和獎金。
本屆賽事已邁入第三屆，以工業自動化、機器人及智慧控制為核心。參賽隊伍須設計並製作全自動搬運機器人(Robot / AGV)，結合影像辨識、自動導航、機械手臂和自動化控制技術，在無人操作情況下，於5分鐘內完成「自動取貨(取出3個彩色方塊及1片金屬板)、迷宮導航、顏色分類、金屬板自動折彎」共五關任務。
而比賽全程禁止人工遙控或介入，強調精準度、運作效率、穩定性與能源管理，貼近工業現場需求。
此次16支隊伍晉級決賽，每隊獲經寶精密提供3萬泰銖製作補助；而評審委員會成員涵蓋多家技術學院校長、職業教育研究發展院所專家、JINPAO技術團隊和產業代表，採計三輪成績中的最佳一次決定最終名次。
經寶長期深耕泰國精密製造、航太和智慧製造領域，並持續投入技職教育與人才培育，本次活動充分展現了經寶作為台商在泰深耕的標竿角色，以及台泰在技職教育、智慧製造與人才培育領域的合作潛力。
paras_en: Thailand's leading precision sheet metal manufacturer jpp-KY, through its partner Jinbao Precision (5284-TW), is offering a prize pool of over 700,000 baht to attract talent and strengthen industry‑academia cooperation by hosting the 2026 JINPAO‑PRAKSA Automation Competition final. This year Princess Sirindhorn of the Thai royal family personally presented the trophy, marking the highest societal recognition of Jinbao’s talent‑development efforts in Thailand.

Jinbao Precision Chairman Zhong Guosong said that after many years of deep involvement in Thailand, the company not only invests in plant construction but also aims to use its accumulated industrial technology to provide Thai youth with a platform to test classroom knowledge and solve real engineering problems.

Zhong believes that automation and robotics are fundamental to the future of industry, and hopes the competition will let students unleash creativity, validate designs in real‑world tasks, and gradually acquire the hands‑on experience needed to enter professional fields.

The 2026 JINPAO‑PRAKSA Automation Competition (industrial automation and robotics for secondary and vocational education) finals were held on October 30‑31 at Praksa Withedsuksa School. Teams from 26 Thai provinces, a total of 43 squads, participated, with the final 16 advancing to compete in three rounds of practical challenges for the royal‑presented trophy and cash prizes.

Now in its third edition, the contest focuses on industrial automation, robotics and smart control. Competing teams must design and build a fully autonomous material‑handling robot (Robot/AGV) that integrates vision recognition, autonomous navigation, robotic arm and control technologies to complete five tasks—automatic picking of three colored blocks and one metal plate, maze navigation, color sorting, and automatic metal‑plate bending—within five minutes without any human remote control.

The competition strictly prohibits any manual remote control or intervention, emphasizing precision, operational efficiency, stability and energy management to mirror real‑world industrial requirements.

Each of the 16 finalist teams receives a 30,000‑baht production subsidy from Jinbao Precision. The judging panel includes deans of several technical institutes, experts from vocational education research institutes, the JINPAO technical team and industry representatives, and the best single score among the three rounds determines the final ranking.

Jinbao has long been deeply involved in Thailand’s precision manufacturing, aerospace and smart manufacturing sectors, continuously investing in vocational education and talent development. This event showcases Jinbao’s role as a benchmark Taiwanese enterprise in Thailand and highlights the collaborative potential between Taiwan and Thailand in vocational education, smart manufacturing and talent cultivation.

items.title: 大陸海警宣布：在台灣以東海域依法展開常態化執法巡查
items.title_en: Mainland China Coast Guard Announces Regular Law Enforcement Patrols in Waters East of Taiwan
paras: 大陸海警局新聞發言人姜略表示，海警虎獅艦編隊31日（周六）在台灣以東海域依法展開常態化執法巡查。
姜略說，10月以來，虎獅艦編隊持續加強相關海域管控，有力確保正常航行和作業秩序，切實維護包括台灣同胞在內的中國民眾合法正當權益和生命財產安全。
姜略稱，海警將持續加強在相關管轄海域執法巡查，堅決維護國家領土主權和海洋權益。
大陸委員會副主任委員沈有忠31日出席安全臺灣學會主辦的「五中全會後，中共內部情勢可能演變與對臺影響」座談會，他強調，民主與威權交鋒是一場長期耐力賽，台灣近年來經濟表現優異，對照於中共日益嚴峻的經濟困境與社會火山悶燒，已經證明民主體制的優越性。
沈有忠呼籲全體國人認清兩岸制度本質上的差異，面對威權侵略野心，必須團結應對，凝聚守護自由民主與國家主權的信念，才能在中共威權政權的複合性施壓下深化民主與繁榮發展。
沈有忠提到，我國地方選舉進入競選最後階段，政府將持續密切掌握中共內部動向與權力演變，以及防制與揭露中共各種介選行為。
paras_en: Mainland China Coast Guard spokesperson Jiang Lue said the Coast Guard’s Tiger‑Lion vessel fleet began a regular law‑enforcement patrol in the waters east of Taiwan on Saturday, the 31st, in accordance with the law.

Jiang noted that since October the Tiger‑Lion fleet has continuously tightened control over the relevant sea areas, effectively ensuring normal navigation and operational order, and safeguarding the legitimate rights and safety of Chinese citizens, including those in Taiwan, as well as protecting lives and property.
He added that the coast guard will keep strengthening patrols in the jurisdictional waters, resolutely defending national territorial sovereignty and maritime interests.

Vice Chairman of the Mainland Affairs Commission Shen Youzhong attended a forum hosted by the Taiwan Security Society on the 31st titled “Post‑5th Plenum: Potential Evolution of Internal CCP Dynamics and Implications for Taiwan,” emphasizing that the clash between democracy and authoritarianism is a long‑term endurance race, and Taiwan’s strong recent economic performance, contrasted with the CCP’s mounting economic woes and social tensions, demonstrates the superiority of democratic systems.

Shen urged all Chinese people to recognize the fundamental institutional differences across the strait, to unite against authoritarian aggression, and to consolidate the belief in defending freedom, democracy and national sovereignty, so that democracy and prosperity can deepen despite the CCP’s multifaceted pressure.

He also mentioned that the country’s local elections are entering the final campaign stage, and the government will continue to closely monitor internal CCP developments and power shifts, as well as prevent and expose various CCP interference activities in elections.

items.title: 光寶科(2301-TW)上修資本支出至197億元，AI電源出貨仍看客戶供電進度
items.title_en: Lite-On Technology (2301-TW) Raises Capital Expenditure to NT$19.7 Billion, AI Power Supply Shipments Still Dependent on Customer Power‑up Progress
paras: 2026年10月31日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 光寶科(2301-TW)10月30日法說會將2026年資本支出由180億元上修至197億元，增加產能擴充與自動化投資。公司預期第四季雲端電源業務可望年增、季增，但AI資料中心的供電瓶頸仍牽動客戶拉貨。新一代800VDC電源櫃預計11月進入系統認證，最快2027年第一季出貨，實際時程與數量仍須配合客戶建置進度。
光寶第三季營收574億元，年增28%，營業利益87億元，年增85%，營業利益率升至15.1%，每股盈餘3.27元創單季新高。其中，雲端及物聯網部門營收338億元、年增57%，占總營收59%。高階伺服器電源與電源管理產品成長，帶動產品組合改善，第三季毛利率達25.9%，高於上半年平均的24.7%。
訂單轉成出貨並非一路順暢。光寶表示，部分客戶先前因供電問題延後拉貨，問題緩解後又集中提貨；客戶仍要求公司依原有預測保留庫存。第三季存貨較前季增加110億元，除客戶安全庫存與全球生產布局，也包括關鍵零組件的策略備料。目前半導體零組件交期可能超過一年，印刷電路板約三至四個月，部分多層板接近六個月，光寶整體備料週期約半年。
800VDC電源櫃則仍在驗證階段。公司說明，首批樣品已於8月底送交產品認證，11月第二批樣品將進行整合系統認證，兩項認證通過後，才有機會在2027年第一季開始實際出貨。這代表送樣與量產交貨仍有時間差，客戶供電及資料中心部署進度，將決定新產品營收何時落袋。
為承接後續需求，光寶越南廣寧新廠預計11月正式啟用，高雄二期廠房已準備就緒，預計12月取得使用執照；美國德州麥金尼廠則規劃2027年第二季正式營運。公司預估2027年資本支出還會高於今年，但尚未提出明確金額。

paras_en: On October 30, Lite-On Technology (2301‑TW) held a legal‑entity briefing and raised its 2026 capital expenditure from NT$18.0 billion to NT$19.7 billion, adding funds for capacity expansion and automation. The company expects its cloud power‑supply business to grow both year‑over‑year and quarter‑over‑quarter in Q4, but power‑supply bottlenecks at AI data centers continue to affect customer order timing. The next‑generation 800 VDC power cabinet is slated for system certification in November, with the earliest shipments possible in Q1 2027, though actual timing and volumes will depend on customers’ deployment schedules.

In Q3, Lite‑On posted revenue of NT$57.4 billion, up 28% year‑over‑year, and operating profit of NT$8.7 billion, up 85%, lifting the operating margin to 15.1%. Earnings per share reached NT$3.27, a quarterly record. The cloud and IoT segment generated NT$33.8 billion in revenue, a 57% increase and accounting for 59% of total sales. Higher‑end server power supplies and power‑management products drove product‑mix improvement, pushing Q3 gross margin to 25.9% versus a 24.7% average in the first half of the year.

Turning orders into shipments has not been smooth. Lite‑On said some customers delayed orders earlier due to power‑supply issues and, after the problems eased, placed concentrated orders; customers still ask the company to keep inventory levels based on original forecasts. Q3 inventory rose by NT$11 billion from the prior quarter, reflecting not only safety stock and global production layout but also strategic stocking of key components. Currently, semiconductor component lead times can exceed a year, printed circuit boards take about three to four months (some multilayer boards close to six months), and Lite‑On’s overall material‑stocking cycle is roughly six months.

The 800 VDC power cabinet remains in the validation stage. The company explained that the first batch of samples was submitted for product certification at the end of August, and a second batch will undergo integrated system certification in November. Only after both certifications are passed could actual shipments begin in Q1 2027. This indicates a gap between sample delivery and mass‑production delivery, and the pace of customer power‑up and data‑center deployment will determine when revenue from the new product materializes.

To meet future demand, Lite‑On’s new plant in Guangning, Vietnam is expected to start operations in November, while the Phase‑2 facility in Kaohsiung is ready and aims to obtain its usage permit by December. The company’s McKinney plant in Texas, USA is planned to commence operations in Q2 2027. Lite‑On forecasts that 2027 capital expenditure will exceed this year’s level, though no specific amount has been disclosed yet.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉研華Q3獲利創高、展望正向 無懼大盤跌千點逆勢收紅
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Advantech Q3 profit hits record, outlook positive, unafraid of market falling 1,000 points, closes higher
paras: 工業電腦大廠研華(2395-TW)第三季獲利飆高，且接單動能續強，在手訂單金額持續增加，第四季展望正向，週五無懼大盤跌千點，逆勢收紅，上漲1%、收680元。
研華第三季稅後純益62.18億元，季增37.63%、年增124.79%，每股純益7.15元，續創單季新高；累計前三季稅後純益140.70億元，年增87.87%，每股純益16.21元，同創同期最佳，且已賺贏去年全年。
研華財務長暨綜合經營管理總經理陳清熙表示，第三季接單出貨比 (B/B Ratio)為 1.64，接單與出貨金額持續季增，三大區域皆較上季成長，其中北美達 2.12，歐洲及中國分別提升至 1.52 及 1.50，顯示整體接單動能保持強勁。
陳清熙指出，儘管原物料成本波動及供應鏈挑戰仍在，但已展開相應布局確保長期供料穩健並延續成本轉嫁機制，可望維持高度營運韌性。
paras_en: Industrial computer giant Advantech (2395-TW) saw its Q3 profit soar, and order momentum remains strong, with the value of orders on hand continuing to rise. The outlook for Q4 is positive, and on Friday the stock closed higher despite the market dropping a thousand points, gaining 1% to NT$680.

Advantech's Q3 after‑tax net profit was NT$6.218 billion, up 37.63% quarter‑over‑quarter and 124.79% year‑over‑year, with earnings per share of NT$7.15, setting a new single‑quarter high. Cumulative net profit for the first three quarters was NT$14.070 billion, up 87.87% YoY, with EPS of NT$16.21, also a record for the period and already exceeding last year’s full‑year profit.

Chief Financial Officer and General Manager of Integrated Operations Chen Qing‑xi said the Q3 order‑to‑shipment ratio (B/B Ratio) was 1.64, with order and shipment values continuing to grow quarter‑over‑quarter. All three major regions posted growth versus the prior quarter, with North America reaching 2.12 and Europe and China rising to 1.52 and 1.50 respectively, indicating that overall order momentum remains strong.

Chen added that although raw‑material cost fluctuations and supply‑chain challenges persist, the company has begun corresponding measures to ensure a stable long‑term supply and to continue its cost‑pass‑through mechanism, which should maintain a high level of operational resilience.

items.title: Meta與中國傅利葉智能合作開發人形機器人？網傳Max僅48公斤、3個月打造
items.title_en: Meta and China’s Fourier Intelligence Collaborate on Humanoid Robot? Rumors Claim Max Weighs 48 kg and Was Built in 3 Months
paras: 社群平台X近日流傳消息，指Meta(META-US) 與中國機器人製造商傅利葉智能（Fourier Intelligence）合作開發一款名為Max的人形機器人，重量約48公斤，從概念發想到實際硬體成形僅花3個月。不過，目前這項消息尚未獲得雙方證實，也沒有公開技術文件或官方公告可以佐證，雙方是否建立正式合作關係仍不明朗。
外媒報導指出，相關調查顯示，目前找不到Meta或傅利葉智能曾發布名為Max的人形機器人，或共同開發相關產品的正式資訊。截至2026年10月，也沒有證據顯示兩家公司已建立正式合作關係。因此，網傳Max的名稱、重量及開發時程，目前都缺乏可供查證的公開資料。
《The Information》週六（31日）亦引述知情人士報導，Meta已與中國新創公司傅利葉智能共同打造一款人形機器人原型，目前正著手開發第二代版本。但《路透》表示目前尚無法立即查證這項報導。
傅利葉智能並非人形機器人領域的新進業者。公司2015年於上海成立，早期主要開發復健外骨骼設備，協助患者恢復肢體活動能力，2023年7月進一步推出GR-1人形機器人，正式拓展人形機器人業務。
此後，傅利葉智能陸續布局GR系列產品。其中，GR-2重量63公斤、身高175公分，具備53個自由度，原定於2024年9月至10月推出；GR-3則預計於2025年8月亮相，重量約71公斤、身高約165公分，具備55個自由度，並透過增加關節活動能力，強化照護相關應用。
不過，傅利葉智能目前公開的人形機器人產品線中，並沒有名為Max的機型。若網傳48公斤的重量屬實，也將比GR-2及GR-3都輕，與公司現有產品規格有所不同。
此外，傅利葉智能目前公開布局的重點也偏向情感陪伴與高齡照護，而非與Meta合作開發新型機器人。
相較於網傳與傅利葉智能合作的消息，Meta進軍機器人領域則有較明確的公開發展。Meta於2025年在旗下Reality Labs部門成立機器人研究團隊，該部門原本主要負責虛擬實境（VR）及擴增實境（AR）硬體業務。
這支團隊由自動駕駛公司Cruise前執行長Marc Whitten領導。Meta將機器人視為可能具有與AR業務同等重要性的長期投資方向，顯示公司正擴大人工智慧（AI）與硬體技術的布局。
此外，Meta於2026年5月收購Assured Robot Intelligence，進一步強化人形機器人AI技術能力。
不過，這些布局目前仍不足以證明Meta已與傅利葉智能合作，或共同開發名為Max的機器人。
paras_en: A recent rumor circulating on X claims that Meta (META-US) and Chinese robot manufacturer Fourier Intelligence have teamed up to develop a humanoid robot named Max, weighing about 48 kg and taking only three months from concept to hardware. However, neither party has confirmed the story, and no technical documents or official announcements exist to substantiate it, leaving the existence of a formal partnership unclear.

Foreign media reports indicate that no evidence has been found that Meta or Fourier Intelligence has released a humanoid robot called Max or jointly developed such a product. As of October 2026, there is no proof that the two companies have established a formal collaboration, and the rumored name, weight, and development timeline lack verifiable public data.

The Information cited insiders on Saturday (31st) saying Meta has worked with the Chinese startup Fourier Intelligence to create a humanoid robot prototype and is now developing a second‑generation version, but Reuters stated that the claim could not be immediately verified.

Fourier Intelligence is not a newcomer to the humanoid robot field. Founded in Shanghai in 2015, the company initially focused on rehabilitation exoskeletons to help patients regain limb function, and in July 2023 it expanded into humanoid robotics with the launch of the GR‑1.

Since then, Fourier Intelligence has rolled out the GR series. The GR‑2 weighs 63 kg, stands 175 cm tall, has 53 degrees of freedom, and was slated for release between September and October 2024; the GR‑3 is expected to debut in August 2025, weighing about 71 kg, standing roughly 165 cm tall, with 55 degrees of freedom and enhanced joint mobility for caregiving applications.

However, none of Fourier Intelligence’s publicly listed humanoid models is named Max. If the rumored 48‑kg weight is accurate, it would be lighter than both the GR‑2 and GR‑3, differing from the company’s current specifications.
Moreover, Fourier Intelligence’s current public focus is on emotional companionship and eldercare, rather than collaborating with Meta on a new robot.

In contrast to the unverified partnership rumors, Meta’s entry into robotics has clearer public developments. In 2025, Meta’s Reality Labs division established a robotics research team, a unit that had previously concentrated on virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR) hardware.

The team is led by Marc Whitten, former CEO of autonomous‑driving firm Cruise. Meta regards robotics as a long‑term investment potentially as important as its AR business, signaling an expansion of its AI and hardware strategy.
In May 2026, Meta acquired Assured Robot Intelligence to further strengthen its humanoid robot AI capabilities.
Nonetheless, these moves do not yet prove that Meta has partnered with Fourier Intelligence or jointly developed a robot named Max.

items.title: 中東緊張局勢再起 黃金為何仍暴跌至一年來最低價？
items.title_en: Middle East Tensions Resurge: Why Is Gold Still Plummeting to Its Lowest Level in a Year?
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，避險資產黃金週五(30日)重挫，跌至一年來最低，這似乎與美國期中選舉週二結束後，中東可能再度陷入動盪的緊張情勢背道而馳。
過去一段時間，當地區衝突或國家間戰爭看似即將爆發，或可能進一步升級時，投資人往往會轉向黃金、美國公債與美元等避險資產。但在美國總統川普第二任期內，許多傳統避險模式已經出現反轉。
推動美股長達四年牛市的科技股漲勢，以及市場可能出現的劇烈反轉，如今似乎也正在改變過去投資人避險的行為模式。
American Gold Exchange總裁Dana Samuelson表示，截至週五，股市大幅拋售下「因資金流動性驅動的避險需求，對貴金屬市場造成附帶傷害」。換言之，投資人在股市遭受損失後急於取得現金，而出售黃金成為籌措資金的方式之一。
根據道瓊市場數據，黃金週五在紐約商品交易所（Comex）收於每盎司3,898.90美元，12月期貨合約當天下跌3.3%。10月以來，金價累計下跌10%，創下2025年10月2日以來最低。
Samuelson表示，股市拋售之際，黃金市場本身已經處於「疲弱且脆弱」狀態，金價當時僅略高於7月形成的重要支撐價位3,975美元。一旦金價跌破這項技術支撐，便進一步加劇跌勢。
美股主要指數週五普遍走低，道瓊工業指數收跌1.1%，標普500指數重挫1.8%，那斯達克綜合指數跌幅最大，下跌2.9%。
期貨經紀商Altavest共同創辦人兼管理合夥人Michael Armbruster表示，「當股市大幅下跌時，人們就會尋求流動性。」
不過，American Gold Exchange的Samuelson表示，整體市場似乎已經「提前反映日益升高的擔憂」，也就是波斯灣地區最快可能在下週出現重大且足以造成局勢動盪的軍事升級。
川普近期的言論確實值得關注。本月稍早，他在社群媒體發文表示，美國不會在11月3日美國大選前對伊朗採取軍事行動，但媒體報導指出，相關方面已擬定重大打擊計畫。
XS.com資深市場分析師Samer Hasn表示，儘管中東局勢升級的風險高漲，且近期可能再度爆發區域戰爭，黃金仍持續承受賣壓，也難以維持較大幅度的反彈。
他在週五的評論中指出，這是因為中東局勢惡化，加上美國經濟展現韌性，可能促使聯準會(Fed)維持「利率在較長時間內居高不下」政策，使美國公債殖利率維持高檔，進而阻礙金價持續復甦。
U.S. Bank Asset Management資深投資策略師Rob Haworth表示，「在科技業財報大致符合預期，以及AI產業賣壓逐漸擴大的背景下，市場最新浮現的消息是成長疑慮。」
他指出，如果AI產業賣壓進一步加劇，尤其是選舉結果顯示民眾反對資料中心擴建，黃金可能因此獲得一些支撐。
從較長期來看，Altavest的Armbruster認為，金價可能進一步走高，尤其是如果聯準會在2027年傾向降息。
他表示，黃金與股市同步下跌的情況，令人聯想到2008年金融危機。當年金價在10月觸底，隨後三年內上漲逾250%。
Armbruster指出，美國政府若要持續為國債融資，就需要大量印鈔。長期來看，這「對黃金極為有利」。他並補充，Altavest已建議看好黃金的投資人「暫時保留資金，等到年底再觀察」。
他最後表示，「現在還不要逢低買進。」
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that the safe‑haven asset gold suffered a sharp drop on Friday (the 30th), sinking to its lowest level in a year, a move that seems at odds with the heightened tension that could see the Middle East plunge back into turmoil after the U.S. mid‑term elections concluded on Tuesday.

In recent periods, when regional conflicts or wars between nations appeared imminent or could potentially escalate, investors typically turned to gold, U.S. Treasury bonds and the dollar as safe‑haven assets. Yet during President Trump’s second term, many traditional safe‑haven patterns have reversed.
The tech‑driven four‑year bull market in U.S. equities and the possibility of a dramatic market reversal now appear to be reshaping investors’ hedging behavior.

Dana Samuelson, president of American Gold Exchange, said that as of Friday, the massive sell‑off in equities created “liquidity‑driven hedging demand that inflicted collateral damage on the precious‑metals market.” In other words, investors, having lost money in stocks, rushed for cash, and selling gold became one way to raise funds.

According to Dow Jones market data, gold closed on Friday on the New York Commodity Exchange (Comex) at $3,898.90 per ounce, with the December futures contract down 3.3% that day. Since October, the price has fallen 10%, hitting its lowest point since October 2, 2025.

Samuelson added that amid the equity sell‑off, the gold market was already “weak and fragile,” with prices only slightly above the key July support level of $3,975. A break below that technical support would likely accelerate the decline.
Major U.S. equity indexes fell across the board on Friday: the Dow Jones Industrial Average slipped 1.1%, the S&P 500 dropped 1.8%, and the Nasdaq Composite posted the biggest loss, falling 2.9%.
Michael Armbruster, co‑founder and managing partner of futures broker Altavest, said, “When the stock market falls sharply, people look for liquidity.”

However, Samuelson of American Gold Exchange noted that the broader market seems to have “pre‑emptively priced in rising concerns,” referring to the possibility of a major military escalation in the Persian Gulf region as early as next week that could destabilize the situation.

Trump’s recent remarks have drawn attention. Earlier this month he posted on social media that the United States would not take military action against Iran before the November 3 U.S. election, though media reports say that plans for a significant strike have already been drafted.

Samer Hasn, senior market analyst at XS.com, said that despite the heightened risk of an escalating Middle‑East crisis and the chance of a renewed regional war, gold continues to face selling pressure and is unlikely to mount a sizable rebound.

In his Friday commentary he explained that worsening Middle‑East tensions combined with a resilient U.S. economy could prompt the Federal Reserve to keep “interest rates high for an extended period,” keeping Treasury yields elevated and hampering any sustained gold recovery.

Rob Haworth, senior investment strategist at U.S. Bank Asset Management, said, “With tech earnings roughly meeting expectations and AI‑sector selling pressure gradually expanding, the latest market narrative is one of growth concerns.”
He added that if AI‑related selling intensifies, especially if election outcomes show public opposition to data‑center expansion, gold could receive some support as a result.
Looking further ahead, Armbruster of Altavest believes gold could rise further, particularly if the Fed leans toward rate cuts in 2027.
He noted that gold’s simultaneous decline with equities evokes memories of the 2008 financial crisis, when gold bottomed in October and then surged more than 250% over the next three years.

Armbruster pointed out that for the U.S. government to keep financing its debt it will need to print large amounts of money, a scenario that is “extremely favorable for gold” in the long run. He added that Altavest has advised investors bullish on gold to “hold funds for now and reassess at year‑end.”
He concluded, “Now is not the time to buy on dips.”

items.title: SanDisk財報超預期股價仍重挫13%！鎧俠示警NAND漲價降溫、記憶體股反轉警報響起
items.title_en: SanDisk Report Beats Expectations, Shares Still Fall 13% – Kioxia Signals Cooling NAND Prices, Memory Stocks Turn Bearish
paras: 記憶體市場漲價動能出現降溫訊號，市場開始重新評估相關類股的成長前景。SanDisk (SNDKV-US) 最新財報全面優於華爾街預期，毛利率更達85%，並上調下季財測、追加50億美元庫藏股及宣布股票1拆8，但股價周五（30日）美股盤前一度重挫8%。拖累股價的關鍵來自日本NAND快閃記憶體大廠鎧俠（Kioxia）。鎧俠最新獲利展望低於市場預期，並釋出過去一年由AI需求推動的記憶體價格飆漲行情可能逐漸趨緩的訊號。
根據《彭博》報導，SanDisk周四（29日）盤後公布財報後，股價反應平淡；直到周五美東時間上午5時54分，市場消化鎧俠的財測後，SanDisk盤前一度跌至1,197.57美元，較周三盤中高點1,419美元回落約16%，美光科技(MU-US) 也受到波及。
截至周五收盤，SanDisk下跌13.47%，美光下跌5.30%。
市場分析人士指出，記憶體產業真正牽動股價的關鍵，不只是價格是否上漲，而是漲價速度能否持續加快。
數據顯示，截至9月的三個月，NAND快閃記憶體平均售價上漲約25%，遠低於前一季約70%的漲幅。

鎧俠獲利展望低於預期 NAND漲價速度放緩

鎧俠預估，本季營業利益將達2兆日元（約127億美元），低於市場預期的2.35兆日元。
回顧截至9月的上一季，鎧俠表現依然強勁，營業利益年增22倍至1.99兆日元，符合市場預期；營收則約2.48兆日元，季增40%。公司也首次宣布發放每股90日元的中期股利。
真正引發市場疑慮的是下一季展望。鎧俠預估本季營業利益約2兆日元，意味著獲利將較前一季幾乎持平，遠低於前一季57%的季增幅，也不及市場原先預期的約18%成長。
《彭博》分析師Takashi Mochizuki指出，鎧俠的財測顯示，過去約一年來前所未見的記憶體價格飆升，正開始進入趨於平穩的階段。
換言之，NAND價格仍在上漲，但漲幅已降至三個月前的約三分之一。對於股價已反映漲價持續加速預期的記憶體企業而言，即使價格仍處於上升週期，漲勢放緩也足以引發估值修正。
此外，記憶體價格持續攀升也開始增加客戶負擔。媒體報導指出，鎧俠高層已警告公司不應過度調漲價格，以免影響與客戶的關係。
英特爾(INTC-US) 周五也預估，今年PC出貨量將下滑約12%，2027年再減少約10%，並將記憶體供應受限列為原因之一。公司更將PC市場出現「出乎意料的嚴重調整」歸因於記憶體價格上漲，消息拖累股價盤前重挫25%。
記憶體類股賣壓隨之擴大。摩根大通市場情報團隊指出，DRAM ETF(DRAM-US) 盤前下跌5.6%，市場重新浮現對AI投資變現能力的疑慮，半導體類股整體承壓。
值得注意的是，鎧俠股價在最新財報公布前，已較6月高點下跌約60%。不過，高盛分析師Jay Narain指出，即使經歷這波修正，鎧俠自2024年12月IPO以來的累計漲幅仍高達2,400%。

SanDisk財報優於預期 仍未達機構投資人高標

單看財報數字，SanDisk上一季表現相當亮眼。根據高盛科技、媒體與電信（TMT）交易團隊彙整，SanDisk營收達110.3億美元，高於市場預期的107.4億美元；毛利率為85.1%，略高於預期的84.9%；非GAAP每股盈餘則達49.51美元，也優於市場預期的46.73美元。
SanDisk對下一季的財測同樣高於華爾街共識，營收中值預估124億美元，非GAAP每股盈餘預估55至57美元，分別高於市場預期的120.8億美元及52.94美元。
但若與高盛自身預測相比，SanDisk的展望仍有落差。高盛原先預估SanDisk下季營收可達135.5億美元，每股盈餘59.71美元，明顯高於公司最新財測。
這反映出部分機構投資人實際期待的業績水準，可能早已超越華爾街公開的平均預估。即使SanDisk交出優於市場共識的成績，仍不足以滿足買方更高的獲利期待。
SanDisk管理層對資料中心業務則相當樂觀。公司表示，目前資料中心約占整體產業位元需求的一半，遠高於2020年的約20%。
展望未來，SanDisk預估，到2030年，KV快取將占AI資料中心市場約35%；2027年，資料中心在NAND市場的占比將超過55%。
管理層也指出，多家客戶先前低估自身NAND需求，公司將按照重新協商後的更高價格供貨。不過，與SanDisk共用晶圓廠的鎧俠最新財測，卻讓市場開始質疑，未來價格調漲空間是否還能維持。
類似情況今年8月也曾發生，當時SanDisk同樣公布全面優於預期的財報，股價卻未能跟著上漲。
高盛分析師Jim Schneider在財報評論中指出，SanDisk目前的長期供貨協議，涵蓋2027會計年度約50%的規劃位元產能，以及2028會計年度約65%，與8月時的比例相同。儘管公司期間又新增兩份協議，截至目前已與8家客戶簽署10份長期合約。
長期協議通常設有價格底線，有助於降低市場波動帶來的衝擊，但也意味著SanDisk明年仍有約一半產能須依照合約市場價格浮動，而鎧俠最新展望已讓市場開始重新評估後續價格走勢。
儘管如此，Schneider仍維持看多立場。他認為，NAND市場在可預見的未來新增供給相當有限，因此將SanDisk 2026至2028年每股盈餘預測上調約7%，並指出公司庫藏股授權額度仍剩105億美元。
他原先預期SanDisk公布強勁季度業績後，股價將溫和上漲，但鎧俠財測公布後，市場反應迅速逆轉。

NAND供需是否反轉？擴產與需求變化成觀察重點

NAND市場價格主要分為現貨價與合約價。現貨價反映即期市場交易，變動較快；合約價則由記憶體製造商與大型客戶定期協商，價格調整通常存在時間落差。
相關分析指出，現貨價格早在6月25日記憶體類股交易熱度見頂當天，就已出現自3月以來停止上漲的跡象。此後，合約價格又連續上漲兩季，如今兩種價格走勢之間的時間差正逐漸縮小。
供給端也出現擴張跡象。鎧俠計畫未來6年與SanDisk在日本投資逾5兆日元擴充產能，部分資金預計透過明年在美國發行美國存託憑證（ADR）籌措，募資規模可能至少達100億美元。
美光則正在新加坡興建一座投資240億美元的NAND工廠；中國長江存儲目前已取得全球NAND市場約13%市占率，與SanDisk相當。中國DRAM大廠長鑫科技(688825-CN) 也在9月跨足快閃記憶體市場。
三星電子的NAND業務表現同樣不如預期。高盛分析師Giuni Lee指出，三星NAND業務獲利略低於預期，位元出貨量與平均售價均稍遜市場預估。
記憶體價格上漲的影響，也逐漸傳導至PC、手機及伺服器等終端市場。高盛分析師Rich Privorotsky指出，記憶體通膨推高硬體成本，正對英特爾PC業務造成壓力。
對整體經濟而言，NAND漲價趨緩有助減輕PC製造商的成本負擔，也可能降低消費者物價指數（CPI）的上行壓力；但對股價已高度反映記憶體持續漲價預期的企業而言，卻可能成為利空。
目前市場對記憶體產業後市出現明顯分歧。
看空一方認為，記憶體本質上仍是高度週期性的產業，過去一年市場卻逐漸將這波漲勢視為結構性成長。
現貨價格3月已見高點，NAND合約價格漲幅也從約70%降至25%，鎧俠下一季獲利展望近乎持平，卻仍計畫投入逾5兆日元擴產。此外，當記憶體價格高到主要客戶難以負擔，廠商也可能面臨出貨與議價壓力。
《彭博》另指出，大型科技公司高達7,500億美元的AI支出，正面臨核心業務成長放緩的挑戰。部分投資人因此擔心，原本被視為消化新增記憶體產能主要來源的超大型雲端服務商（Hyperscalers），未來可能開始採取更強硬的議價策略。
但多方認為，目前NAND價格單季仍上漲約25%，放在歷史水準來看仍屬罕見強勢，資料中心需求也具備長期結構性成長動能。 此外，鎧俠管理層的財測也可能刻意採取保守態度，未必代表整個記憶體產業已經正式進入下行週期。
paras_en: Memory market price‑growth momentum shows signs of cooling, prompting a reassessment of growth prospects for related stocks. SanDisk (SNDKV-US) released a quarterly report that far outperformed Wall Street expectations, with a gross margin of 85% and an upward revision of next‑quarter guidance, a $5 billion share‑repurchase, and a 1‑to‑8 stock split. Yet on Friday (30th) the stock fell sharply in pre‑market trading, dropping about 8%. The key drag on the share price came from Japanese NAND flash memory giant Kioxia. Kioxia’s latest earnings outlook fell short of market expectations and signaled that the AI‑driven memory price surge of the past year may be easing.

According to Bloomberg, after SanDisk released its earnings on Thursday (29th) after‑hours, the stock reaction was muted. It wasn’t until 5:54 a.m. Eastern on Friday that the market digested Kioxia’s guidance and SanDisk’s pre‑market price fell to $1,197.57, roughly 16% lower than the Wednesday intraday high of $1,419, also dragging Micron Technology (MU-US) down.
By Friday’s close, SanDisk had fallen 13.47% and Micron down 5.30%.
Market analysts point out that the real driver of memory stock prices is not simply whether prices rise, but whether the rate of price increases can accelerate further.
Data show that over the three months ending in September, the average price of NAND flash memory rose about 25%, far below the roughly 70% increase seen in the prior quarter.

Kioxia’s earnings outlook falls short of expectations, slowing the pace of NAND price hikes. Kioxia forecasts operating profit of 2 trillion yen (about $12.7 billion) this quarter, below the market‑expected 2.35 trillion yen.

Looking back at the quarter ending September, Kioxia remained strong, with operating profit up 22× year‑over‑year to 1.99 trillion yen, in line with expectations; revenue was about 2.48 trillion yen, up 40% quarter‑on‑quarter. The company also announced a first‑time interim dividend of 90 yen per share.

The real concern is the next‑quarter outlook. Kioxia projects operating profit of about 2 trillion yen, implying earnings will be almost flat versus the prior quarter, far below the 57% quarterly growth seen previously and well under the roughly 18% growth originally expected.
Bloomberg analyst Takashi Mochizuki noted that Kioxia’s guidance shows the unprecedented memory price surge of the past year is entering a more stable phase.

In other words, NAND prices are still rising, but the rate of increase has fallen to about one‑third of what it was three months ago. For memory companies whose shares had already priced in accelerating price growth, a slowdown is enough to trigger a valuation correction.

Moreover, the continued rise in memory prices is increasing customer costs. Media reports indicate that Kioxia executives have warned the company not to raise prices too aggressively to avoid damaging customer relationships.

Intel (INTC-US) also forecasted on Friday that PC shipments would decline by about 12% this year and by another 10% in 2027, citing constrained memory supply as one reason. The company also blamed the “unexpectedly severe adjustment” in the PC market on rising memory prices, which dragged the stock down 25% in pre‑market trading.

Memory‑related stocks faced further selling pressure. JPMorgan’s market intelligence team noted that the DRAM ETF (DRAM-US) fell 5.6% pre‑market, as doubts resurfaced about the monetization of AI investments, putting pressure on the broader semiconductor sector.

Notably, Kioxia’s share price had already fallen about 60% from its June high before the latest earnings release. However, Goldman Sachs analyst Jay Narain pointed out that even after this correction, Kioxia’s cumulative gain since its December 2024 IPO remains 2,400%.

SanDisk’s earnings beat expectations but still fell short of institutional investors’ high targets. On paper, SanDisk’s last quarter was impressive. According to a synthesis by Goldman Sachs’ TMT team, SanDisk’s revenue was $11.03 billion, above the $10.74 billion expected; gross margin was 85.1%, slightly higher than the 84.9% forecast; non‑GAAP EPS was $49.51, beating the $46.73 expected.

SanDisk’s next‑quarter guidance also exceeded Wall Street consensus, with median revenue estimates of $12.4 billion and non‑GAAP EPS of $55–57, versus consensus estimates of $12.08 billion and $52.94.

But compared to Goldman Sachs’ own forecast, SanDisk’s outlook still falls short. Goldman had originally projected next‑quarter revenue of $13.55 billion and EPS of $59.71, clearly higher than the company’s latest guidance.

This reflects that some institutional investors’ actual performance expectations may already have surpassed the publicly available consensus. Even with earnings that beat consensus, SanDisk’s results still fail to satisfy buyers’ higher profit expectations.

SanDisk’s management is very optimistic about its data‑center business. The company says that data‑center demand now accounts for about half of total industry bit‑rate demand, far above the roughly 20% in 2020.
Looking ahead, SanDisk estimates that by 2030, KV cache will account for about 35% of the AI data‑center market; by 2027, data‑center demand will exceed 55% of the NAND market.

Management also noted that several customers had previously underestimated their NAND needs, and the company will supply at higher prices after renegotiation. However, Kioxia’s latest guidance, which shares a foundry with SanDisk, has led the market to question whether future price increases can still be sustained.
A similar situation occurred in August, when SanDisk also posted a strong earnings report but the stock failed to rise.

Goldman Sachs analyst Jim Schneider noted that SanDisk’s current long‑term supply agreements cover about 50% of planned bit‑rate capacity for FY2027 and about 65% for FY2028, the same proportions as in August. Despite adding two more agreements during the period, the company has now signed 10 long‑term contracts with eight customers.

Long‑term agreements typically set price floors, helping to mitigate market volatility, but also mean that about half of SanDisk’s capacity will still be subject to market‑price fluctuations next year, and Kioxia’s latest outlook has prompted the market to reassess future price trends.

Nevertheless, Schneider remains bullish. He believes that the NAND market has limited new supply in the foreseeable future, so he raised SanDisk’s 2026‑2028 EPS forecast by about 7% and noted that the company still has $10.5 billion of share‑repurchase authorization left.
He originally expected SanDisk’s strong quarterly performance to lift the stock modestly, but after Kioxia’s guidance was released, the market reacted quickly in the opposite direction.

Is the NAND supply‑demand balance reversing? Expansion and demand shifts are key points of observation. NAND market prices are divided into spot and contract prices. Spot prices reflect immediate market transactions and move quickly; contract prices are negotiated periodically between memory manufacturers and large customers, with a lag in price adjustments.

Analysts note that spot prices stopped rising on June 25, the day memory stocks peaked, and have since been flat since March. Contract prices have risen for two consecutive quarters, and the time lag between the two price streams is narrowing.

Supply side also shows expansion signals. Kioxia plans to invest over 5 trillion yen in Japan over the next six years to expand capacity, with some funding expected to come from next year’s ADR issuance in the U.S., potentially raising at least $10 billion.

Micron is building a $24 billion NAND plant in Singapore; China’s Yangtze Memory Technologies already holds about 13% of the global NAND market, comparable to SanDisk. China’s DRAM giant Changxin Technology (688825‑CN) also entered the flash memory market in September.

Samsung Electronics’ NAND business also underperformed expectations. Goldman Sachs analyst Giuni Lee noted that Samsung’s NAND profitability was slightly below expectations, with bit‑rate shipments and average selling prices both slightly below market forecasts.

The impact of rising memory prices is gradually spilling over into PC, mobile, and server end markets. Goldman Sachs analyst Rich Privorotsky said that memory inflation is raising hardware costs, putting pressure on Intel’s PC business.

For the broader economy, a slowdown in NAND price growth could ease PC manufacturers’ cost burdens and potentially reduce CPI upward pressure; but for companies whose shares already heavily reflect expectations of sustained memory price increases, it could be a downside factor.
The market currently shows clear disagreement on the memory industry’s outlook.
Bearish investors argue that memory remains a highly cyclical industry, yet the past year’s price surge has been increasingly viewed as structural growth.

Spot prices peaked in March, and NAND contract price increases fell from about 70% to 25%; Kioxia’s next‑quarter earnings outlook is almost flat, yet the company plans to invest over 5 trillion yen in expansion. Moreover, when memory prices become too high for major customers to bear, manufacturers may face shipment and pricing pressure.

Bloomberg also noted that large tech companies’ AI spend of up to $750 billion face challenges from slowing core‑business growth. Some investors worry that hyperscalers, once seen as the main source of new memory capacity absorption, may adopt tougher bargaining tactics in the future.

But many believe that NAND prices are still rising about 25% in the current quarter, which remains historically strong, and that data‑center demand has long‑term structural growth momentum. Additionally, Kioxia’s guidance may be deliberately conservative and does not necessarily indicate that the entire memory industry has entered a downturn.
